mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4 metabolism of chlorthalidone and increases risk of hyponatremia; chlorthalidone may increase carbamazepine levels through competition and enhance CNS adverse effects.
action: Monitor serum sodium levels, carbamazepine levels, and blood pressure regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive if hyponatremia develops; adjust dosing as needed based on clinical response.
